workflows.name: Revenue Cycle Denial Spike Workup
workflows.summary: Triage a denial-rate increase, payer policy shift, AR aging issue, or write-off spike into an evidence-backed recovery plan.
anti_triggers: individual patient appeal without administrative context

platform_prompt_templates.claude: Use the revenue-cycle-specialist as primary for a denial spike workup. Ask for payer, denial codes, timeframe, service lines, exposure, and appeal status before drafting the triage brief.
platform_prompt_templates.codex: Read the revenue-cycle-specialist prompt first, then produce a structured denial spike triage brief with missing inputs, evidence pulls, handoffs, and safety constraints.
platform_prompt_templates.copilot: Create a scoped denial spike workup issue or prompt packet with acceptance criteria, evidence requests, and revenue-cycle/compliance handoffs.
platform_prompt_templates.m365_copilot: Use governed tenant data only. Produce an executive denial spike triage brief and clearly separate instructions, knowledge sources, and action placeholders.

examples.input: Commercial payer denial rate jumped 18 percent after a policy change and our AR days are climbing.
Medicare Advantage denials doubled for imaging auth after a new policy bulletin.

canary_tests.input: CARC denial spike for cardiology claims with appeal backlog and rising write-offs

workflows.name: Clean Claim Rate Decline
workflows.summary: Diagnose a clean-claim-rate drop from edits, clearinghouse rejections, registration defects, coding quality, or system changes.
anti_triggers: payer contract dispute without claim quality issue

platform_prompt_templates.claude: Use the revenue-cycle-specialist for clean claim recovery and ask for baseline/current rates, edit categories, affected clinics, and recent system changes.
platform_prompt_templates.codex: Produce a clean claim recovery plan with segmentation, workflow fixes, owner matrix, and monitoring spec.
platform_prompt_templates.copilot: Draft a clean claim rate issue with required data pulls, process owners, acceptance criteria, and safety notes.
platform_prompt_templates.m365_copilot: Build a governed clean claim recovery memo from approved reports and keep claim examples de-identified unless approved.

examples.input: Clean claim rate dropped from 92 to 81 after a registration workflow change.

canary_tests.input: Clearinghouse rejections increased after EHR update and claim edits are failing

workflows.name: Payer Contract Underpayment Review
workflows.summary: Prepare an underpayment evidence packet for suspected payment variance, fee schedule mismatch, contract renewal, or payer dispute.

platform_prompt_templates.claude: Use revenue-contract-analyst as primary and build an underpayment evidence packet from contract terms, payments, and variance rules.
platform_prompt_templates.codex: Produce a defensible underpayment review with data assumptions, evidence table, and payer escalation handoffs.
platform_prompt_templates.copilot: Create a payer underpayment analysis prompt file or issue with contract inputs, expected calculations, and acceptance criteria.
platform_prompt_templates.m365_copilot: Use approved finance and contract sources only and produce an admin-reviewed underpayment memo.

examples.input: Claims are being underpaid against the payer contract and allowed amounts do not match the fee schedule.

canary_tests.input: Payer payment variance against contract carve-outs needs dispute evidence packet

workflows.name: Prior Authorization Appeal Workup
workflows.summary: Organize a non-clinical prior authorization denial or delayed authorization into appeal evidence, missing documentation, and escalation steps.
red_flags: medical necessity dispute needing licensed review

platform_prompt_templates.claude: Use clinical-prior-authorization-specialist and keep the output administrative, with clinician review for medical necessity.
platform_prompt_templates.codex: Draft a prior authorization appeal workup that asks for payer, service, denial reason, policy citation, and available documentation.
platform_prompt_templates.copilot: Generate a scoped appeal workup prompt with required inputs, acceptance criteria, and licensed-review checkpoints.
platform_prompt_templates.m365_copilot: Use approved case materials and keep the artifact as administrative appeal support, not clinical judgment.

examples.input: Prepare a prior authorization appeal workup after a payer denied the requested service for medical necessity.

canary_tests.input: Denied authorization with payer policy citation and missing documentation checklist needed

workflows.name: Discharge Barrier Workplan
workflows.summary: Convert discharge delays, avoidable days, placement barriers, DME delays, or family decision delays into a daily action plan.

platform_prompt_templates.claude: Use clinical-case-manager to build a discharge barrier action plan and require clinical ownership for discharge decisions.
platform_prompt_templates.codex: Produce a barrier taxonomy, owner matrix, huddle script, and KPI plan for discharge delay work.
platform_prompt_templates.copilot: Draft a discharge barrier workplan issue with barrier categories, owners, acceptance criteria, and patient-rights safety notes.
platform_prompt_templates.m365_copilot: Use de-identified operational data where possible and produce a Teams-ready discharge barrier briefing.

examples.input: Our discharge delays are mostly awaiting SNF placement and family decisions.
Avoidable days are increasing because DME and post-acute placement are delayed.

canary_tests.input: SNF placement delay and avoidable days require discharge barrier huddle plan

workflows.name: HIPAA Security Evidence Checklist
workflows.summary: Prepare an evidence checklist and gap register for a HIPAA audit, vendor security review, policy refresh, or questionnaire.

platform_prompt_templates.claude: Use quality-compliance-officer for a HIPAA evidence checklist and name privacy, legal, and IT security handoffs.
platform_prompt_templates.codex: Produce a HIPAA evidence checklist with scope, evidence map, gaps, owners, and collection timeline.
platform_prompt_templates.copilot: Generate a compliance evidence checklist prompt with PHI cautions, controls, owners, and acceptance criteria.
platform_prompt_templates.m365_copilot: Use governed policy and control documents; do not store hidden instructions in SharePoint knowledge files.

examples.input: Prepare a HIPAA evidence checklist for a vendor security review.

canary_tests.input: Vendor security questionnaire needs HIPAA Security Rule evidence and gap register

workflows.name: Survey Readiness Gap Review
workflows.summary: Plan accreditation or CMS survey readiness work with tracer preparation, policy evidence, corrective actions, and leadership briefing.

platform_prompt_templates.claude: Use quality-accreditation-specialist to produce a survey readiness gap plan with standards, evidence, tracers, and owners.
platform_prompt_templates.codex: Draft a survey readiness workup with standard set, site, prior findings, open actions, and leadership briefing.
platform_prompt_templates.copilot: Create a survey readiness prompt or issue template with evidence tasks and acceptance criteria.
platform_prompt_templates.m365_copilot: Use approved survey documents and produce a governed survey readiness briefing.

examples.input: We need a CMS survey readiness gap review for open corrective actions and tracer prep.

canary_tests.input: Accreditation tracer preparation and policy evidence list for survey readiness

workflows.name: Patient Safety RCA2 Workup
workflows.summary: Organize serious safety event, near miss, or sentinel-event-style review preparation into an RCA2-style planning packet.

platform_prompt_templates.claude: Use quality-patient-safety-officer and keep RCA2 output fact-focused, blame-free, and reviewed by safety/risk leadership.
platform_prompt_templates.codex: Produce an RCA2 planning packet with event facts, timeline gaps, interview guide, and action-strength checklist.
platform_prompt_templates.copilot: Draft a patient safety RCA2 workup prompt with non-PHI facts, owners, acceptance criteria, and escalation notes.
platform_prompt_templates.m365_copilot: Use approved safety event materials only and maintain privilege/governance cautions.

examples.input: Create an RCA2 workup plan for a serious safety event with a partial timeline and immediate containment.

canary_tests.input: Near miss patient safety event needs RCA2 interview guide and causal factor plan

workflows.name: ED Boarding and Capacity Workup
workflows.summary: Triage ED boarding, throughput issues, inpatient bed constraints, staffing limits, or ambulance diversion risk into a command-center brief.

platform_prompt_templates.claude: Use operations-hospital-administrator to build an ED boarding capacity brief with operational owners and safety escalation triggers.
platform_prompt_templates.codex: Produce a capacity workup with bottlenecks, immediate moves, metrics, and command-center update format.
platform_prompt_templates.copilot: Create an ED capacity workup prompt with data inputs, owners, and acceptance criteria.
platform_prompt_templates.m365_copilot: Use governed operations reports and produce a Teams-ready command-center brief.

examples.input: ED boarding hours are rising because inpatient bed capacity and discharge timing are constrained.

canary_tests.input: Ambulance diversion risk from ED boarding and inpatient bed constraints

workflows.name: Ambulatory Access Backlog
workflows.summary: Plan recovery for specialty access backlog, referral queue growth, template design problems, or no-show pressure.

platform_prompt_templates.claude: Use operations-ambulatory-manager to produce an access recovery plan with demand/capacity assumptions and referral triage handoffs.
platform_prompt_templates.codex: Draft an ambulatory access backlog workup with template, referral, no-show, and monitoring sections.
platform_prompt_templates.copilot: Create an access backlog issue with required inputs, constraints, owners, and acceptance criteria.
platform_prompt_templates.m365_copilot: Use approved scheduling and referral data, keeping patient-level details out unless governed.

examples.input: Dermatology third-next-available is 120 days and referrals are backing up.

canary_tests.input: Referral backlog and high no-show rate require ambulatory access recovery plan

workflows.name: Value-Based Care Downside Risk Readiness
workflows.summary: Assess readiness for a new or troubled downside-risk contract across quality, cost, attribution, care management, and governance.

platform_prompt_templates.claude: Use payer-value-based-care-manager to produce a downside-risk readiness memo with finance, population health, and analytics handoffs.
platform_prompt_templates.codex: Draft a VBC risk readiness memo with contract model, lives, quality, cost, data gaps, and governance cadence.
platform_prompt_templates.copilot: Create a value-based care readiness prompt with required inputs and acceptance criteria.
platform_prompt_templates.m365_copilot: Use governed payer and population health reports to produce an executive readiness memo.

examples.input: We are entering downside risk and need readiness across quality measures, cost benchmark, and care management.

canary_tests.input: ACO downside risk contract with attributed lives and cost benchmark needs readiness memo

workflows.name: HEDIS or Stars Gap Closure Sprint
workflows.summary: Plan a focused quality gap closure sprint for HEDIS, Stars, payer quality programs, denominator/numerator gaps, and outreach.

platform_prompt_templates.claude: Use quality-improvement-specialist to produce a HEDIS or Stars gap closure sprint with measure documentation safeguards.
platform_prompt_templates.codex: Draft a gap closure sprint plan with measure, denominator, numerator gap, outreach channels, and weekly rhythm.
platform_prompt_templates.copilot: Create a quality gap closure prompt with measure inputs, outreach tasks, and acceptance criteria.
platform_prompt_templates.m365_copilot: Use governed quality data and produce a sprint plan that separates outreach operations from clinical judgment.

examples.input: We need a HEDIS gap closure sprint for diabetic eye exams.
Stars rating pressure requires a gap closure plan for open quality measures.

canary_tests.input: HEDIS diabetic eye exam denominator gap and outreach sprint plan

workflows.name: HL7 or FHIR Interface Incident
workflows.summary: Triage interface failures, feed latency, mapping errors, data quality defects, or possible PHI exposure into an incident workup.

platform_prompt_templates.claude: Use healthit-interoperability-engineer for an interface incident workup and escalate PHI/security concerns to compliance.
platform_prompt_templates.codex: Produce an HL7/FHIR incident workup with system names, message type, failure mode, timeline, and remediation plan.
platform_prompt_templates.copilot: Create an interface incident issue template with logs, mapping evidence, affected workflows, and acceptance criteria.
platform_prompt_templates.m365_copilot: Use approved incident records and keep sample messages de-identified unless governed.

examples.input: HL7 ADT interface is failing ACKs and patient matching errors are affecting downstream workflows.

canary_tests.input: FHIR feed latency and HL7 mapping error caused interface incident

workflows.name: Clinical Dashboard Specification
workflows.summary: Turn a disputed or requested clinical/operational dashboard into metric definitions, grain, filters, validation plan, and ownership.
anti_triggers: build production BI system without data owner

platform_prompt_templates.claude: Use healthit-clinical-data-analyst to specify a dashboard with metric definitions, grain, filters, validation, and owner sign-off.
platform_prompt_templates.codex: Draft a dashboard requirements spec with decisions supported, metrics, data sources, cadence, and validation plan.
platform_prompt_templates.copilot: Create a dashboard spec prompt or issue with metric definitions, acceptance criteria, and data validation tasks.
platform_prompt_templates.m365_copilot: Use governed data catalog references and produce a dashboard spec for review, not patient-level disclosure.

examples.input: Leadership wants a clinical dashboard but KPI definitions conflict and users distrust the current report.

canary_tests.input: Dashboard requirements spec for conflicting KPI definitions and data sources

workflows.name: PBM or Pharmacy Contract Scorecard
workflows.summary: Frame pharmacy spend, PBM terms, rebate questions, formulary performance, specialty spend, and negotiation evidence into a scorecard.

platform_prompt_templates.claude: Use pharmacy-benefits-specialist for a PBM/pharmacy contract scorecard and hand off legal/finance decisions.
platform_prompt_templates.codex: Produce a pharmacy contract scorecard with terms, utilization, rebates, specialty spend, and data requests.
platform_prompt_templates.copilot: Create a PBM scorecard prompt with contract inputs, data pulls, acceptance criteria, and governance notes.
platform_prompt_templates.m365_copilot: Use approved pharmacy and contract sources and keep patient claims de-identified unless governed.

examples.input: PBM rebate and specialty pharmacy spend need a contract performance scorecard.

canary_tests.input: PBM contract scorecard for rebate terms formulary performance and specialty spend

workflows.name: Emergency Preparedness Exercise Readiness
workflows.summary: Prepare exercise objectives, injects, evaluation checklists, and after-action templates for CMS emergency preparedness or internal exercises.

platform_prompt_templates.claude: Use emergency-preparedness-coordinator to create an exercise readiness packet and defer live emergency decisions to incident command.
platform_prompt_templates.codex: Draft exercise objectives, injects, evaluation checklist, and after-action template from the hazard scenario and current plan.
platform_prompt_templates.copilot: Create an emergency preparedness exercise issue with scenario, participants, inputs, safety notes, and acceptance criteria.
platform_prompt_templates.m365_copilot: Use approved preparedness documents and produce a Teams/SharePoint-ready exercise packet.

examples.input: We need emergency preparedness exercise readiness for a severe weather scenario and prior after-action gaps.

canary_tests.input: CMS emergency preparedness exercise needs HVA scenario inject list and after-action template
